suhas: Heads-up — noticed a steady drop in prefix cache hit-rate for /v1/generate (model=redwood-7b) over the last 14d. From ~36% down to ~18%. :thinking:
perf-bot: alert: cache_hitrate_drop detected route=/v1/generate model=redwood-7b pct_drop=50% window=14d
claire: on it. plotting hit-rate vs p50/p99 latency now. quick glance: tail latency up ~20ms and p50 up ~6ms correlated with hit-rate dip.
ben: was there any infra or runtime change around the start of the window? kernel selector change or batching tweak?
suhas: we rolled kernel selector v2.1 for 7b on 2026-03-01 and also merged a batching heuristic change (dynamic folding) the following day. also a prefix normalizer change hit main on 2026-03-02.
claire: pulled sample traces for three tenants (acme, betaco, dryrun). acme is showing the largest hit-rate regression.
ben: I did a quick profile: KV lookup latencies steady, but observed prefix key collisions ~3x higher in the affected window. suspect the normalizer introduced subtle canonicalization differences.
raja: action items: 1) canary-rollback normalizer for one pod group 2) add dashboard panels: prefix_cache.key_cardinality, prefix_cache.collisions, prefix_cache.hitrate_by_tenant, prefix_cache.tokens_saved_rate 3) add alert: tokens_saved delta >20% over 24h for any tenant.
claire: I can add the panels. example query I'm going to wire in Grafana:
```
SELECT tenant, model, route, avg(hitrate) as h, sum(tokens_saved) as saved
FROM prefix_cache_metrics
WHERE time >= $__from AND time <= $__to
GROUP BY tenant, model, route
ORDER BY saved DESC
```
ben: also add kernel selector dims: kernel.selected_version and batching.window_ms to the dashboard to correlate.
suhas: can we surface per-model+route breakdown (not just tenant) — ops wants token-saved by model for SLA math.
